tools.name: purchase_flag_evaluation_quota
tools.description: Charges the customer's saved card for extra flag evaluations and raises the project's monthly evaluation quota by the purchased amount.

params.name: project_key
params.description: Key of the flag project to top up

params.name: extra_evaluations
params.description: Number of additional evaluations to buy, in multiples of 1000

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("feature-flags")

DB_PATH = "flags.db"
CENTS_PER_THOUSAND = 5


def _charge_customer(customer_id, amount_cents, project_key):
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Flag evaluation quota for {project_key}",
        metadata={"project_key": project_key},
    )
    return intent


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_flag_evaluation_quota(project_key: str, extra_evaluations: int, customer_id: str) -> dict:
    if extra_evaluations <= 0 or extra_evaluations % 1000 != 0:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "extra_evaluations must be a positive multiple of 1000"}

    amount_cents = (extra_evaluations // 1000) * CENTS_PER_THOUSAND
    intent = _charge_customer(customer_id, amount_cents, project_key)
    if intent.status != "succeeded":
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"payment status: {intent.status}"}

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE projects SET monthly_eval_quota = monthly_eval_quota + ? WHERE key = ?",
            (extra_evaluations, project_key),
        )
        conn.commit()
        updated = cur.rowcount
    finally:
        conn.close()

    return {
        "ok": updated == 1,
        "payment_intent": intent.id,
        "charged_cents": amount_cents,
        "added_evaluations": extra_evaluations,
    }

tools.name: grant_flag_environment_access
tools.description: Gives a team member a role on a flag project's environment through the flag service's admin API and posts a notice about the new access to the team's Slack webhook.

params.name: environment
params.description: Environment name such as staging or production

params.name: member_email
params.description: Email of the member receiving access

params.name: role
params.description: Role to grant: viewer, editor, or admin

tools.code:
import os

import requests

ADMIN_API = os.environ.get("FLAG_ADMIN_API", "https://flags.example.com/api/v2")
ADMIN_TOKEN = os.environ.get("FLAG_ADMIN_TOKEN", "")
SLACK_WEBHOOK = os.environ.get("SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL", "")


def grant_flag_environment_access(project_key: str, environment: str, member_email: str, role: str) -> dict:
    result = {"ok": False, "granted": False, "notified": False}

    if role not in ("viewer", "editor", "admin"):
        result["error"] = "invalid role"
        return result

    headers = {"Authorization": ADMIN_TOKEN, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    resp = requests.post(
        f"{ADMIN_API}/projects/{project_key}/environments/{environment}/members",
        json={"email": member_email, "role": role},
        headers=headers,
        timeout=15,
    )
    if resp.status_code not in (200, 201):
        result["error"] = f"admin api returned {resp.status_code}"
        return result
    result["granted"] = True
    result["membership_id"] = resp.json().get("id")

    if SLACK_WEBHOOK:
        text = f"{member_email} was given {role} access to {project_key}/{environment}"
        notice = requests.post(SLACK_WEBHOOK, json={"text": text}, timeout=10)
        result["notified"] = notice.ok

    result["ok"] = True
    result["role"] = role
    return result
